iti72:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti72:2.1: “Monks, there are these three properties for escape.
iti72:2.3: This is the escape from sensuality: renunciation. This is the escape from form: formlessness. And as for whatever has come into being, is fabricated & dependently co-arisen, the escape from that is cessation.
iti72:2.4: These are the three properties for escape.”
iti72:3.3:
–ardent
always–
touching the stilling
of all fabrications:
iti72:4.1:
he is a monk
who’s seen rightly.
iti72:4.2: From that he is there released.
iti72:4.3:
A master of direct knowing,
at peace,
he is a sage
